title: Canadian scientists in the legacy program

tellings.quote: because Canadian scientists have been and are involved in the legacy program.

plain: Canadian scientists have worked, and still work, inside the legacy program, the secret effort that some say recovers and studies craft of non-human origin. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this as something he has been told, without naming who said it. If true, the program would reach beyond the United States.
